assertions.title: Influence of Droplet Size and Fuel Composition on Sooting Behavior in Microgravity Droplet Combustion

conflicting_assertions.note: The PSI file inventory places these IDs under N_Octane. Do not resolve the contradiction by guessing or assign additional labels to these runs.

diameter_references.note: Backlit 1024x1024 TIFF imagery and approximate field size are described. This is not an exact-run spatial calibration or an initial-diameter table.
Deployment proceeds through a liquid bridge, needle retraction and droplet relaxation. A pre-ignition image need not contain a relaxed free droplet. No exact run IDs were found in the searched paper.

manual_event_log_review.note: Each DOCX contains an embedded screenshot. Visually inspected original embedded PNGs; fields are test ID, igniter timing/wattage/positions, burn timing, events and camera image counts. No oxygen, gas mixture, initial droplet diameter or calibrated flow value is present.
